title: "01-snp-filtering"
author: "Matt DeSaix"
date: "2024-09-05"
output: html_document
---

I create the `gsmnp-10k-full-525_62134` data based on Rachael identifying the individuals of interest in GSMNP boundaries.

```{sh}
plink=../software/plink-1.9/plink
bfile=./data/genotypes/buffer-10k/grsm-10k-full-571_62134
outname=./data/genotypes/buffer-10k/grsm-10k-geno_0.05-maf_0.05-571_35641
outname=./data/genotypes/buffer-10k/filtered/grsm-10k-geno_0.05-maf_0.05-571_35641
${plink} --noweb --bfile ${bfile} --geno 0.05 --maf 0.05 --make-bed --out ${outname}
```

LD filtering

```{sh}
plink=../software/plink-1.9/plink
bfile=./data/genotypes/buffer-10k/filtered/grsm-10k-geno_0.05-maf_0.05-571_35641
outname=./data/genotypes/buffer-10k/filtered/grsm-10k-geno_0.05-maf_0.05-571_35641

${plink} --noweb --bfile ${bfile} --indep-pairwise 10 1 0.5 --out ${outname}
```


```{sh}
wc -l ./data/genotypes/buffer-10k/filtered/grsm-10k-geno_0.05-maf_0.05-571_35641.prune.in
```



```{sh}
plink=../software/plink-1.9/plink
bfile=./data/genotypes/buffer-10k/filtered/grsm-10k-geno_0.05-maf_0.05-571_35641
extract=./data/genotypes/buffer-10k/filtered/grsm-10k-geno_0.05-maf_0.05-571_35641.prune.in
outname=./data/genotypes/buffer-10k/grsm-10k-final-571_10508

${plink} --noweb --bfile ${bfile} --extract ${extract} --mind 0.95 --make-bed --recode A --out ${outname}
```
